title: Neck Reset
steps: Tilt your head left, then right.

title: Desk Opener
steps: Stand up and clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your chest gently for 20 seconds.
Relax and shake out your arms.

title: Wrist Release
steps: Pull your fingers down lightly, then up.

title: Chair Twist
steps: Sit tall with both feet grounded.
Rotate slowly to one side and hold.
Return to center and switch sides.

title: Shoulder Roll
steps: Roll both shoulders forward five times.

title: Chest Lift
steps: Interlace your fingers behind your back.
Lift your chest without crunching your neck.

title: Seated Side Bend
steps: Lean gently to the opposite side.

title: Upper Back Reach
steps: Clasp your hands in front of you.
Press forward and round your upper back.

title: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: Press the rear heel toward the floor.

title: Ankle Rolls
steps: Circle your ankle five times each way.

title: Forearm Stretch
steps: Use the other hand to pull the palm back.

title: Hip Stand
steps: Place your hands on your hips.
Shift weight side to side for 20 seconds.

title: Hamstring Reach
steps: Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Switch sides after a few breaths.

title: Jaw Unclench
steps: Relax your tongue from the roof of your mouth.

title: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Support it with the opposite hand.

title: Overhead Triceps Stretch
steps: Bend the elbow and guide it lightly.

title: Mini Backbend
steps: Stand and place hands on your lower back.

title: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Hold a wall or desk if needed.
Bring one heel toward your seat.

title: Heel Raises
steps: Lift your heels and lower slowly.

title: Toe Taps
steps: Tap your toes up and down quickly.

title: Seated Figure Four
steps: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Switch sides after a few breaths.

title: Desk Push Away
steps: Place both palms on your desk edge.
Step back and hinge at the hips.

title: Rib Expansion
steps: Place hands on your lower ribs.

title: Side Step Reset
steps: Take five steps to one side.

title: Pelvic Tilt
steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair.
Tilt your pelvis forward and back gently.

title: Neck Nod
steps: Lift back to neutral, not past it.

title: Temple Massage
steps: Use two fingers at your temples.

title: Hand Shakeout
steps: Shake out your hands for ten seconds.

title: Elbow Openers
steps: Circle your elbows forward and back.

title: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Place your forearm on a doorway or wall edge.

title: Standing Side Reach
steps: Reach one arm up and over.

title: Low Shoulder Drop
steps: Lift both shoulders toward your ears.
Drop them completely on the exhale.

title: Desk Lunge
steps: Stand and step one foot back.

title: Inner Wrist Stretch
steps: Press your palms together at chest height.
Lower your hands until you feel a stretch.

title: Outer Wrist Stretch
steps: Make a soft fist with one hand.

title: Seated Reach and Fold
steps: Fold forward over your legs gently.

title: Standing Twist
steps: Rotate your torso side to side.

title: Desk Plank Lean
steps: Place your hands on the desk.
Step back into a light incline plank.

title: Foot Roll
steps: Roll through the ankle and toes.

title: Glute Squeeze
steps: Squeeze your glutes for five seconds.

title: Towel Pull Apart
steps: Hold a towel or imagine one between your hands.

title: Sit to Stand
steps: Stand up from your chair without rushing.

title: Posture Reset
steps: Place both feet flat on the floor.
Lengthen the back of your neck.
